facts.fact: Olivia 独自困在黑暗里：看不见的房间里传出呻吟、争吵和猫叫似的声响，她压住恐慌，独自往前走。
facts.anchor: Voices echoed from unseen rooms—groans, arguments, mewling sounds like cats. I fought panic, alone in the dark.

facts.fact: 她把走廊尽头一个瘦削的年轻男子当成真人，悄悄朝他跑过去，撞上的却是一面镜子。
facts.anchor: Once, I glimpsed a slim young man at the end of a corridor; I ran silently toward him but crashed into a mirror.

facts.fact: 她终于在通道尽头找到一道楼梯，抓住扶手，小心地往上一层走。
facts.anchor: At last I came to a staircase at the end of a passage. I grabbed the banister and warily began walking to the next floor.

facts.fact: 上一层只有极微弱的灰光从脏污的菱形窗格漏进来，卷起的地毯被推到墙边当路障，地板与窗台都落满灰尘。
facts.anchor: Very faint gray light leaked through grimy, diamond-paned windows. Barricades of rolled-up carpets had been pushed against the walls.

facts.fact: 呻吟声越来越响，还伴着有节奏的砰砰声，像是从一只衣柜里传出；她瞥见里面有个又大又白、蛆虫似的东西在暗处动，转身就逃。
facts.anchor: The groaning grew louder, accompanied by a rhythmic thump-thump-thump. It seemed to come from a wardrobe.

facts.fact: 墙后传出两个女人的声音：一个轻声哭喊，另一个在笑，笑声却像被人捂住嘴一样被掐断，她喊出 Tamsin 与 Tallulah 的名字。
facts.anchor: I heard a woman’s soft cry. A second woman giggled, but the sound was cut short, as though someone had clapped a hand over her mouth.

facts.fact: 她拐进一间厅堂，里面堆着几百年的旧箱子，全被撬开翻过，里面的东西撒在摇摇晃晃的地板上——枯干的人发假发、破烂的小山羊皮手套。
facts.anchor: a hall filled with centuries-old trunks that had been flung open and ransacked, their contents spilled on the rickety floor

facts.fact: 一只手抓住她的手臂，另一只手捂住她的嘴，一个男人低声说「别喊，Livvie」——来人是她的表哥 Simon。
facts.anchor: A hand grabbed my arm; another hand covered my mouth.
